item.title: Welp, Nobody Saw SpaceX’s Falcon 9 Rocket Crash Into the Moon

item.title: Dutch Bros Coffee buys dozens of Salad and Go stores that abruptly closed: See a full list of locations in 4 states
item.description: The salad chain’s collapse turned out to be good fortune for Dutch Bros, which shares a drive-through-focused format. Here’s where the new stores will be. The dust has not yet settled on Salad and Go’s surprise bankruptcy and the abrupt closure of all of its locations, but a fellow Arizona-based restaurant brand is not wasting any time.
